reason: The finding is out of date. At 27 Sep 11:08Z the user issued E10 v3 (CONTEXT l.2917-2926, commit 61e0737). It replaces the v1/v2 thresholds and lifts P6's ban on successor + insertion. Under v3 the trigger is a public notebook scoring >= 0.955, not >= 0.956. The actions run autonomously with push notifications: (A) a verbatim copy, (B) the copy plus our DaughterNet insertion when the x138 anchors apply, (C) the successor's change ported into K2 otherwise. Runtime evidence is <= 12 h, not L_hi <= 7.5 h. The finding still says 'v1 in force, no new OK' and 'no-insertion port only, otherwise ask', and wants that copied into the RESUME POINT, which would write a superseded rule into the resume point. The threshold matters: the LB snapshot experiments/e10_watch/20260927T1101Z.txt shows 74 teams at exactly 0.955 (254 at >= 0.955), so 0.955 is the most likely score for a public successor, and a >= 0.956 runbook misses exactly that case. The cadence is also stale. research/wf_ideas_v4/e10v3/build_watch.notes.md shows an hourly E10 v3 watch being built from 11:12Z. The 3-hourly schedule of timer 2e87e414 (13 checks) adds up to ~2 h of lag, and ties at the same score go to the earlier submission. tools/e10_port_gate.py hard-codes REPAIR_DEADLINE_S = 27000 (l.28/78/594), so a successor that changes its deadline would fail the static gate, and v3 action (C) is not covered at all. The time arithmetic is fine: a check at 00:04Z leads to a submit at ~01:05Z, and even a +12 h run is scored by ~13:05Z, before the 20:00Z tick. The value estimate (+0.001-0.006 P(bronze), P(trigger) 1-3% at 0.956) cannot be checked and was computed for the wrong threshold. Current evidence: no public notebook is above 0.953 (scoreDescending top is HF v3 0.953; amanatar v6 is unscored).
fix: Do not copy the v1 runbook. Write the RESUME POINT runbook against E10 v3. (1) Trigger: page score >= 0.955 on the latest version M, which must itself be scored; a newer unscored version means wait. (2) Pull -m; P4b(a) metadata fixes; every source public and listable; record version M. (3) (A) verbatim copy: byte-identical notebook, private, internet off, then dummy, then submit. Run static checks for R7 (no test-scoring PP sweep or validator, no cached CSV). Do NOT run the 27000-deadline check for (A); record the runtime from the author's run (<= 12 h) instead. (4) (B) copy + SI only if the divinsert anchors apply exactly once; e10_port_gate + dummy gate (0 FAIL/SKIP); fail-soft insertion. (5) (C) only when (B) cannot apply, with its own dummy. (6) Push notification at the trigger and at each submit; poll < 15 min old; 60 s backoff on 429; NEVER_SUBMIT / dryrun guards stay. (7) Finals: never re-tick without the user; send the composition proposal in chat. (8) Cadence: the hourly v3 watch, last check ~00:04Z, last submit 29 Sep ~02:00Z if the run is <= 7.5 h and earlier (by ~12:00Z minus runtime margin) if it is <= 12 h. Also retire the '>= 0.956' and 'no-insertion only' lines wherever they still appear in P6/V4.
realistic_gain: About 0 as written; it would be negative if the stale >= 0.956 rule suppressed a 0.955 trigger. The corrected v3 runbook is worth roughly +0.002-0.01 P(bronze) (P(public successor >= 0.955 by 29 Sep 00:00Z) ~3-8%, times the finals value of a port). It still depends on the user re-ticking the finals.
